display.description: Backend Elastic-operation signals only (otel_scope_name=focustrack-elastic, elastic_operation=search). NOT full HTTP/browser latency. Custom metrics currently require the service identity fix rollout; pre-fix window data is unreliable. See docs/observability.md.
display.name: FocusTrack Search

display.description: outcome=error share of search operations. Missing error series becomes 0 ONLY when total traffic is positive (or vector(0) on numerator); no traffic renders empty, never false 100% success. No denominator clamping.
display.name: Error percentage (%)

spec.query: (sum(rate({otel_metric_name="focustrack.elastic.operations", elastic_operation="search", otel_scope_name="focustrack-elastic", instance!="", outcome="error"}[5m])) or vector(0)) / sum(rate({otel_metric_name="focustrack.elastic.operations", elastic_operation="search", otel_scope_name="focustrack-elastic", instance!=""}[5m])) * 100

display.description: search_mode=lexical-fallback share of search operations. Missing fallback series becomes 0 ONLY when total traffic is positive (or vector(0) on numerator); no traffic renders empty. No denominator clamping.
display.name: Lexical-fallback percentage (%)

spec.query: (sum(rate({otel_metric_name="focustrack.elastic.operations", elastic_operation="search", otel_scope_name="focustrack-elastic", instance!="", search_mode="lexical-fallback"}[5m])) or vector(0)) / sum(rate({otel_metric_name="focustrack.elastic.operations", elastic_operation="search", otel_scope_name="focustrack-elastic", instance!=""}[5m])) * 100

display.description: p95 of focustrack.elastic.duration_ms for search operations only. Backend Elastic signal, not end-to-end HTTP/browser latency. Dots in metric name preserved via otel_metric_name selector. No service_name matcher: Prometheus mapping emits job=focustrack for custom metrics.
display.name: Backend Elastic p95 latency (ms, target < 800)

display.description: Rate of focustrack.elastic.operations with elastic_operation=search. Backend operation throughput, not HTTP request rate.
display.name: Search operations / sec
